notes: New since 5.5.0: description tooltips for attacks, spells, items, features and NPC actions (no chat needed; long ones scroll and stay open); spell slots left by level, including pact slots, with -/+ on Classic sheets; token markers on and off; End turn when your token is up (ticks a Round counter); right-click anything to pin it to Favorites; tracking of actions, bonus actions, reactions and movement each turn; concentration save DCs and death saves; the bar lights up on your turn. Changes to markers, turns and slots are limited to the GM and the character's player. Unofficial; not affiliated with Roll20.
